image: apps/gpu-power-id vendor-state variant (build.py --vendor-state), port 3-1, the last image of its lifetime

approval.text: Approved for GPU clock and voltage as well
approval.scope: GPU clock and voltage changes, for example the vendor operating point of 1008 MHz from the GPU PLL at 960 mV; each with its own design and an approval record naming the rail and values (docs/handoff.md)
approval.coordinator: On 2026-10-25 the coordinator accepted one image that applies the GPU PLL clock, the DCDC4 voltage and the BL31 secure setup in the vendor order.

voltage.pmic: AXP8191 at I2C address 0x36, through the S_TWI0 provider
voltage.write_path: a733_pmic_submit_write of apps/gpu-power-id/vendor-state-pmic.c under an exclusive DCDC4 rail token: the provider reads the six snapshot bytes, requires the output enabled at selector 0x1e, writes 0x2e and reads it back; a mismatch retains the request
voltage.reference: sunxi_platform.c:899-901 and 473-485 (regulator_enable, sunxiSetVoltage 960 mV, udelay 200); axp2101-regulator.c:383-410 (ramp 250 uV/us: 160 mV in 640 us, rounded up to 1 ms); sun60iw2p1.dtsi:4736-4739 (opp@1008000000, opp-microvolt-vfdefault 960000)

restore: None. The image makes no OFF and leaves DCDC4 at 960 mV and the GPU clock at 1008 MHz until the power removal that ends its lifetime.
